MINUTES OF THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN PLATINUM (PRIVATE) LIMITED (“COMPANY”) HELD ON __________________ 
 
 Present 
 
 Mariam Saleem Akbar Chief Executive / Director 
 Adil Ahmad Kamal Director 
 
 Mariam Saleem Akbar chaired the meeting (“ Chairman ”). 
 
 Agenda 
 
 AMENDMENT TO THE LOAN AGREEMENT WITH ZAMEEN VENTURE ONE (PRIVATE) LIMITED 
 
 The Board was informed that the Company desires to extend the Termination Date of the loan availed by the Company from Zameen Venture One (Private) Limited (“ Lender ”) under the loan agreement dated 4 April 2019, as amended by the Amendment dated 3 April 2020 (collectively, the “ Loan Agreement ”), to 30 June 2024. 
 
 The Board unanimously nominated Mariam Saleem Akbar , Chief Executive of the Company, to discuss, negotiate, and accept this proposal. 
 
 Resolutions 
 
 After discussing the aforesaid matter in detail, the following resolutions were passed/approved/adopted by the Board: 
 
 Resolved , that the Termination Date of the loan availed from the Lender under the Loan Agreement be extended to 30 June 2024. 
 
 Resolved further, that Mariam Saleem Akbar be and is hereby authorized and empowered to do and execute all such acts, deeds and things as may be necessary and ancillary to the aforementioned transaction.

 Company Secretary
